answer: Proof-of-stake based Sybil resistance ensures that every identity must bond capital to validate transactions. In a decentralized graph, each agent acts as a vertex where the cost of entry is tethered to the economic ridge of staked assets. If an adversary attempts to sybil the network, they must traverse a financial garden of bonded collateral, making identity fragmentation prohibitively expensive as the marginal cost of forging new nodes scales linearly with the total value locked by the attacker.
